---
pagetitle: "quarto-hi template showcase"
output-file: index.html
lang: en
title-theme: "QUARTO-HI"
subtitle-highlight: "Template Showcase"
presenters:
  - name: "Your Name"
    hi-username: "username"
    orcid: "0000-0000-0000-0000"
subtitle-position: below
event-meta: "Your Event"
event-date: today
menti_url: "https://www.menti.com/example"
menti_display_url: "www.menti.com"
menti_code: "1234 5678"
menti_qr: "img/menti-qr.png"
format:
  revealjs:
    theme: styles/hi.scss
    css:
      - styles/watermark.css
    filters:
      - _extensions/hi-title/hi-title.lua
      - _extensions/card-enum/card-enum.lua
      - _extensions/pause/pause.lua
      - _extensions/menti/menti.lua
    logo: img/hi/hi_named_logo-en.svg
    footer: "quarto-hi · University of Iceland"
    include-in-header: partials/header-includes.inc
    include-after-body: partials/body-after.inc
    slide-number: false
    controls: true
    transition: none
    background-transition: none
    width: 1280
    height: 720
---

{{< hi-title >}}

::: {.notes}
- Title slide is generated from YAML front matter by the `hi-title` filter
- Fields: `title-theme`, `subtitle-highlight`, `presenters`, `event-meta`, `event-date`
- `subtitle-position: below` swaps title and subtitle order
- `event-date: today` → resolves at render time in English or Icelandic
:::

## What's in this template

::: {.fa-card cols=3}
- palette | **HI Visual Identity** | Jost font, HI colour palette from honnun.hi.is, watermark background
- layer-group | **Component Library** | cards, quotes, steps, layouts, callouts, countdowns and more
- puzzle-piece | **Lua Extensions** | hi-title · card-enum · pause · menti
:::

::: {.notes}
- Everything needed for a polished HI-branded RevealJS deck
- Extensions are bundled — no separate install
- Works with `quarto use template tungufoss/quarto-hi`
:::

---

## fa-card — syntax

<span class="slide-subtitle">`::: {.fa-card cols=N}` · one list item per card: `- icon | **Title** | body`</span>

::: {.two-col}
::: {}
```markdown
::: {.fa-card cols=2}
- lightbulb | **Insight** | supporting detail
- users | **Audience** | who this affects
:::
```

- Icon: any [Font Awesome](https://fontawesome.com/icons) solid name
- `[brands] github` prefix for brand icons
- `**bold**`, `_italic_`, `` `code` `` work anywhere
- `cols=` sets cards per row — excess wraps to next row
- Add `/subtitle text` as 3rd segment for a small label above the body
:::

::: {}
::: {.fa-card cols=2}
- lightbulb | **Insight** | /Step 1 | supporting detail
- users | **Audience** | who this affects
:::
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
- card-enum.lua processes the fenced div into HTML grid
- Three widths available: cols=1, cols=2, cols=3 (more is possible but gets cramped)
:::

---

## fa-card — colours

**Default** — all blue

::: {.fa-card cols=3}
- star | **One** | body text
- heart | **Two** | body text
- bolt | **Three** | body text
:::

**Per-item override** — prefix icon with `[hi-red]`, `[hi-teal]`, `[hi-pink]` etc.

::: {.fa-card cols=3}
- star | **One** | body text
- [hi-red] heart | **Two** | stands out in red
- bolt | **Three** | body text
:::

::: {.notes}
- Default: all cards are blue — consistent and clean
- Prefix any icon with [hi-red] / [hi-teal] / [hi-pink] / [hi-yellow] / [hi-orange] / [hi-green] to override that card's colour
- Useful for highlighting a key card or warning
:::

---

## fa-card — extended syntax

<span class="slide-subtitle">Sub-bullets `* item`, formula `~ text`, inline icons `[icon-name]`</span>

::: {.fa-card cols=2}
- chart-bar | **With sub-bullets** | supporting description | * First bullet point | * Second bullet point | * Third bullet point
- function | **With formula** | two inputs combine | ~ [arrow-up] Input [plus] Context [arrow-right] Output
:::

::: {.lean-in}
`- icon | title | body | * bullet | * bullet` · `- icon | title | body | ~ [icon] text`
:::

::: {.notes}
- Pipe-separated: icon | title | body | extras
- * prefix → bullet list inside the card body
- ~ prefix → formula line; [icon-name] renders FA icons inline
:::

## Steps

<span class="slide-subtitle">`::: {.steps}` · one list item per step: `- Label | description`</span>

::: {.steps}
- Define | the problem scope
- Design | the intervention
- Implement | and observe
- Evaluate | outcomes
:::

::: {.lean-in}
Colours cycle automatically through the HI palette.
:::

::: {.notes}
- .steps generates chevron-shaped step chips
- Up to 6 steps — colour cycling: blue → teal → yellow → orange → red → green
- Use | to split label from sub-label (both optional)
:::

::: {.callout}
Designing assessment **for** professional competence, not just testing it.
:::

::: {.statement}

::: {.notes}

- .callout → yellow background, bold emphasis
- .statement → clean left-rule for thesis statements

## Layouts & blocks

<span class="slide-subtitle">`.two-col` · `.three-col` · `.img-split` · `.block` variants</span>

::: {.two-col}
::: {}
**Left column** — text, lists, or any content.

- Point one with some detail
- Point two with more detail

::: {.block}
**Definition** — neutral, blue border.
:::

::: {.example-block}
**Example** — teal tint, positive framing.
:::
:::

::: {}
**Right column** — same flexibility.

::: {.block .alert}
**Alert** — yellow tint, caution or caveat.
:::

::: {.block .danger}
**Danger** — red tint, error or critical warning.
:::

::: {.lean-in}
Stack blocks with `.block-grid` for consistent spacing.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
- .two-col: equal 1fr 1fr grid
- .three-col: three equal columns
- .img-split on the slide header: text left, full-height image right
:::

## Image split layout {.img-split}

::: {.slide-content}
<span class="kicker">Layout</span>
<h2 class="r-fit-text">img-split</h2>

Add `.img-split` to the slide heading to get a full-height image panel on the right.

::: {.block}
Text and components go in `.slide-content`. The image fills the right panel edge-to-edge.
:::
:::

<figure>
<img class="slide-img" src="img/pop-pallas.jpg" alt="">
</figure>

::: {.notes}
- .img-split slides have no padding — image bleeds to edges
- Control ratio with CSS vars --img-split-text-width / --img-split-image-width
:::

## AI-generated image {.img-split}

::: {.slide-content}
<span class="kicker">Prompt engineering</span>
<h2>AI-generated image</h2>

Use `.img-split` with a `<figure>` and `<figcaption class="caption-prompt">` to show an AI-generated image with the prompt visible. Add `data-ai="Gemini"` (or Midjourney, DALL·E…) to name the tool.

::: {.block}
`<figcaption class="caption-prompt" data-ai="Gemini">` → **GEMINI PROMPT ·**
Omit `data-ai` → **PROMPT ·**
:::
:::

<figure>
<img class="slide-img" src="img/pop-pallas.jpg" alt="Pop Art Pallas Athena">
<figcaption class="caption-prompt" data-ai="Gemini">Pop Art (Warhol): A bold Warhol-style for University of Iceland Pallas Athena logo — each panel a vivid screenprint colour. Palette: #10099F #2DD2C0 #FAC55B #FC8484 #FFA05F on white. Thick outlines, flat halftone dots, no text, portrait mode.</figcaption>
</figure>

::: {.notes}
- data-ai="Gemini" → "GEMINI PROMPT · " via CSS attr()
- data-ai="Midjourney" → "MIDJOURNEY PROMPT · " — any string works
- Omit data-ai → plain "PROMPT · "
:::

## Pause — in-class countdown

<span class="slide-subtitle">Shortcode: `pause` followed by duration in seconds</span>

::: {.two-col}
::: {}
Insert a timed break with a live countdown clock.

Syntax: two braces, `< pause 300 >`, two closing braces — where `300` is the number of seconds.

- Always in seconds (`300` = 5 min, `600` = 10 min)
- Clock ticks live in the browser
- Slide background turns yellow when time is up
- Language-aware: **Break** (EN) / **Pása** (IS)
:::

::: {}
::: {.block}
The `pause` extension lives in `_extensions/pause/`. Add `pause.lua` to your filters list.
:::
::: {.lean-in}
The next slide is a live 30-second pause example — click the arrow to see it.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
- Great for workshops, lectures, and in-class exercises
- The countdown runs client-side via body-after.inc JavaScript
:::

## Menti — audience response

<span class="slide-subtitle">Set credentials in YAML · use `.menti-login` for the entry slide · `data-menti="true"` for question slides</span>

::: {.two-col}
::: {}
**YAML front matter:**

```yaml
menti_url: "https://www.menti.com/..."
menti_display_url: "www.menti.com"
menti_code: "1234 5678"
menti_qr: "img/menti-qr.png"
```

**Login slide:**
```markdown
## {.focus-slide .menti-login intro="Scan the QR code"}
```

**Question slide** (embeds live Menti):
```markdown
## {data-menti="true"}
```
:::

::: {}
::: {.block}
The `menti` extension reads credentials once from YAML and injects them into every login and question slide automatically.
:::
::: {.example-block}
The next two slides show a live login slide and a question slide — with placeholder credentials.
:::
:::
:::

::: {.notes}
- menti.lua is in _extensions/menti/
- Add _extensions/menti/menti.lua to filters
- QR code image must be provided separately — export from Menti
:::
